newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS TENDER FOR 1-DAY REPO - 1000 CET.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS TENDER FOR 1-DAY REPO - 1000 CET.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia on Wednesday, looking to add liquidity to the interbank money market, said it had set a tender for one-day securities repurchase for 1000 CET.
The NBS said in a statement the American-style tender would have a minimum rate of 9.7 percent.
According to official NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector is short of liquidity, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 97.04 percent as of Tuesday.
On Tuesday, the NBS said it would hold tenders on a daily basis if needed at a set time 1000 CET, instead of quoting securities repo and reverse repo rates.
It said tender results would be released at 1100 CET with allocations following later in a day.
